objective: Prevent known classes of false success, wasted clean evidence, hidden dependency, infrastructure misclassification, statistical luck, and composition failure before untouched qualification evidence is spent.

failure_classes.defense: Frozen 19-family target envelope plus complete behavioral leaves and explicit acceptance scope
Independent requirement extraction plus requirement-to-consumer traceability; unresolved ambiguity fails closed
At least two structurally independent extraction/interpretation routes or one deterministic parser plus adversarial challenger; disagreements surfaced
Independent acceptance model rejects shared non-raw dependencies and builder-derived checks
Requirement mutation and verifier mutation suites must kill seeded critical faults

Pre-exposure identity plus complete zero-hit search across Brain+runner code, branches, commits, and PR metadata; immutable exposure ledger; automatic ineligibility after any task-specific instruction/solution/verifier/hint leakage.
Development/validation/final qualification partitions disjoint; no post-reveal candidate change
Predeclared estimator, confidence method, sample size/stop rule and familywise error control before results
Verifier tested against known-pass, known-fail, metamorphic, mutation and differential cases
Leave-domain-out/adversarial transfer plus explicit abstention outside verified envelope
Physical donor deletion/network denial plus dependency/SBOM accounting and clean-room rerun
Pinned revision, source hash, license and derivative-use compatibility recorded before internalization
Current feasibility certificate proves a $0 route, resource envelope and hard stop before qualification
Live executor heartbeat, artifact roundtrip, path contract, permissions, rate-limit budget and verifier reachability preflight
Exact base binding, blocker lease, liveness receipt and duplicate-open-intent rejection
Latency/memory/storage/throughput bounds included in behavioral contract and tested where material
Exact tool authority/availability/permission probes bound to execution context
Pairwise/t-way interaction suite plus adversarial mixed-capability scenarios before terminal closure
Pinned benchmark/model reference, harness version and acceptance bar; drift forces re-adjudication
Direct terminal-effect evidence required; proxy-only improvements receive zero promotion credit

Before fresh qualification, require at least one current plausible route satisfying ownership, $0, knowledge boundary, license and execution constraints; otherwise decompose or return exact impossibility boundary
Runner binds explicit canonical execution_count_allowed and terminal_verifier_count_allowed, consumes each unit before invocation, and fails closed after exhaustion.

Before untouched Stage-C spend, prove package/install/runtime behavior on the exact task image or a materially equivalent container. Equivalence must cover OS/base image, runtime provenance, package-management policy including PEP 668 or analogous restrictions, shell, permissions, artifact paths, required native libraries, and network assumptions. A host-only or setup-python probe is insufficient when the task container differs.

Stage-B dependency feasibility must bind to the exact built task-container READY execution_surface_profile or a separately proven-equivalent container. PEP-668/external-management state, Python identity, venv usability and safe install policy may not be inferred from GitHub setup-python or host Python. If task-specific non-system packages are required, Stage-B must verify the selected venv/portable install route on the equivalent package-management surface before Stage-C authorization.

observed_failure_repairs.observed: Stage-B feasibility passed on GitHub Actions setup-python CPython 3.12, while the actual Ubuntu 24.04 task image used Debian-managed Python and rejected system pip under PEP 668. The one allowed builder burst was spent before task audio analysis.
observed_failure_repairs.repair: Require exact-or-materially-equivalent task-container execution-surface parity before Stage-C authorization.
observed_failure_repairs.fresh_evidence_cost_avoided: Generic environment/package failures must be discovered before untouched qualification execution.
